item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: The junior girls' basketball team is very excited to host the EOSSAA AA Basketball Championships this coming Tuesday, November 17th. They can't wait to represent STA on their home court in front of the best fans who make the most noise in Prescott Russell! The schedule will be out soon. Please come out and support the girls and get loud STA!!!

item.title: A message from Ms. Timmins:
item.description: If you're interested in trying out for the Varsity Girls' Hockey Team this year, there will be an important information meeting next Tuesday, November 17th, in Room 219 at the beginning of lunch. Please see Ms. Timmins if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Ms. McMartin:
item.description: Thank you to all 7/8 students who participated in the UofWaterloo BCC contest yesterday. The university will send me your results in early December. There will be an announcement when they arrive.

item.title: A message from M. Décoste
item.description: For 7/8 Boys Volleyball: Please check the new list posted on Athletic Board. We will be having a meeting at 9:05 this morning in room 148.
